page_title: STR 1-3 LOR | Strasbourg v Lorient 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is shown a red card by the referee for chasing his opponent and bringing him down with a very nasty tackle!
90+3' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will take the corner.
90+3' Emanuel Emegha receives a sweet cross inside the box from Andrey Santos (Strasbourg), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
90+1' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) and Kevin Gameiro combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Bamba Dieng (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mohamed Bamba walks off.

90' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
87' Angelo (Strasbourg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isaak Toure (Lorient) was quite harsh and Thomas Leonard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' That's a well-taken pass by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
84' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
81' The linesman raises his flag. Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
80' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Habib Diarra will be replaced by Rabby Inzingoula (Strasbourg).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is replacing Junior Mwanga.
79' Half-chance! Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) plays a pass into the box, but Alaa Bellaarouch reacts well to snuff out the attack.
78' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
78' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Julien Ponceau (Lorient) inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
76' Angelo (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball.
74' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
73' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

72' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
70' The referee awards a corner and Julien Ponceau (Lorient) goes over to take it.
70' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Yvon Mvogo.
69' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
66' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
65' Angelo (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Yvon Mvogo scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
62' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) replaces Ayman Kari.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gedeon Kalulu leaves the pitch and Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) comes on.
61' The corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is hurriedly cleared.
61' Angelo (Strasbourg) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
59' Ayman Kari (Lorient) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
57' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
56' Here comes a substitution. Ismael Doukoure is given a rest as he is replaced by Angelo (Strasbourg).
56' Here is a change. Marvin Senaya is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
56' Here's the change. Jessy Deminguet leaves the pitch and Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.

55' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
54' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
53' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

51' 1 - 3 Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Dilane Bakwa. His header was precise and ended up in the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:3.
51' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

49' 0 - 3 Goal! The ball breaks to Julien Ponceau (Lorient) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 0:3.
48' Strasbourg showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Theo Le Bris produces a brilliant lofted pass and Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:2.
45+1' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Thomas Leonard is going to take a look using VAR.
45+1' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Montassar Talbi is substituted due to injury. Regis Le Bris gives a chance to Julien Laporte (Lorient).
44' The game is interrupted now, Montassar Talbi (Lorient) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Yvon Mvogo is alert and denies him.
40' Yvon Mvogo leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
40' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Strasbourg.
38' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) takes the corner kick, but Alaa Bellaarouch reads it well and stops the effort.
35' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the left side of the goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch answers with a superb save to deny him.
33' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
33' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Strasbourg have a corner.
32' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
31' Strasbourg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
30' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
26' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
26' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) commits a foul and Thomas Leonard immediately signals a free kick.
25' Ayman Kari (Lorient) tries to find Mohamed Bamba with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
25' The percentage of ball possession is – 69:31.
23' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
22' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
21' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will take a corner kick.

21' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Strasbourg will have a corner.
20' Half-chance! Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) plays a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
18' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
17' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
14' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked.
14' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece.
12' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.

11' The corner is slung over and Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
10' The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) plays a through ball but overhits it.
7' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) brings an opponent down and Thomas Leonard interrupts the game.
6' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
5' The Strasbourg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Here comes the VAR decision from the ref - no infringement, the goal is given!
3' The Lorient players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Leonard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

2' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
